newsitem.title: USA: Gibson's Discount Centers files for bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Gibson's Discount Centers files for bankruptcy.

text.p: Gibson's Discount Centers Inc, its parent and an affiliate filed for Chapter 11 protection Wednesday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.
The company listed assets of $44 million and liabilities of $40.5 million.

Also filing were the parent, Gibson's Holding, and Gibson Franchise Corp. The companies are based in Dodge City, Kansas and sell discount merchandise at retail. Gibson's Discount reportedly has 22 stores in seven states.
